bio: The view of the Scheldt River and the docks makes this restaurant's terrace one of the finest in Antwerp! Thanks to all the windows, the water feels omnipresent, even if you are seated inside. Charcoal sketches by Rinus Van de Velde lend an arty feel to the sleek interior. The extensive menu is dominated by traditional favourites. The fried sole is an obvious classic, but for something truly special, try the crispy veal sweetbreads in a brown stock and port sauce. The generous portions certainly go down well. And for those in a hurry, a quick lunch is always available, too....
